description: Declarative, versioned pattern list for graphsmith postmortem's shell-command classification (Lane F, .plans/gsa-followup/LANE-F-CODING-SESSION-POSTMORTEM-DESIGN.md Part 3b). Externalized into its own data file mirroring scripts/risk-policy.json's separation from scripts/capability-policy.js, per that design doc's explicit instruction. This is a CLASSIFICATION aid, not a proof of anything -- it can only recognize command shapes; it never inspects whether a command actually succeeded (see schemas/session-trace.schema.json stats.observability.verifyOutcome, always 'unavailable' in v1). scripts/postmortem-classify.js is the only reader of this file.

verify_command_patterns.description: Substrings (case-insensitive) that mark a shell command as verify-shaped (test/build runner). The first ten entries are the exact, source-confirmed mindwalk verifyCommand() list (internal/adapter/adapter.go), reproduced byte-for-byte: 'go test, go vet, npm test, npm run build, pnpm test, pnpm build, pytest, make test, cargo test, swift test' -- confirmed to NOT include jest/vitest/mvn test/dotnet test/tox/rspec. The design doc's Part 3b explicitly directs this list to be adapt-not-adopt and EXTENDED 'for GraphSmith's less Go/JS-narrow audience' (GraphSmith itself targets Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf/Devin, Hermes, and Copilot users across many stacks, not mindwalk's own narrower Go-tooling test corpus). The extension below is a disclosed, deliberate GraphSmith-side addition -- flagged explicitly, not silently folded in as if mindwalk already had it.

search_programs.description: Program basenames (case-insensitive) that only inspect the tree the way Grep/Glob/LS would. Source-confirmed from mindwalk's searchPrograms map.

read_only_programs.description: Program basenames that never mutate anything and carry no path-target signal on their own (used as the 'harmless in a pipeline segment' allowlist for both search- and read-command classification). Source-confirmed from mindwalk's readOnlyPrograms map.

read_programs.description: Program basenames that page file contents the way Read would (cat/head/tail/nl, plus the sed -n '...p' file idiom handled specially in code). Source-confirmed from mindwalk's readPrograms map.

tool_action_map.description: Direct tool-name -> action mappings, borrowed as-is from mindwalk's actionFor() switch (both Claude Code and Codex tool names share one table since the taxonomy is harness-agnostic).
